links.comparator_used: Eight UQ techniques compared against each other across AF detection and blood pressure regression tasks
links.outcome: Reliability of uncertainty estimates (global calibration, local calibration, adaptivity)
links.effect: No numbers in the abstract; the best technique depended on the task, the expression of uncertainty, the evaluation metric and the scale of reliability assessed.
links.quote: We observe a complex picture of uncertainty reliability across the different techniques, where the most optimal for a given task depends on the chosen expression of uncertainty, evaluation metric, and scale of reliability assessed.
